key_highlights: ASX under pressure as oil prices rise and AUD strengthens, though energy and large-cap miners provide partial support
Global bond market rout raises financial crisis 'trajectory' concerns, pressuring rate-sensitive sectors
Iron ore prices crumbling, with BHP.AX facing existential strategic questions amid structural demand decline
Australian housing prices accelerating downward; property sector facing 'GFC moment' with RBA signalling no intervention
Mortgage rates rising week-over-week; Australians increasingly reliant on second jobs as cost-of-living pressure intensifies
Gold miners (Forrestania, Kaiser, Manhattan, Larvotto) delivering strong results; gold remains a key safe-haven narrative amid geopolitical risk
Ultra-rich US investors rotating out of equities into cash, signalling risk-off global positioning

sectors.trend: Divergent: iron ore in structural decline pressuring BHP.AX and FMG.AX, while gold (Forrestania, Kaiser, Manhattan, Larvotto) and uranium (Infini) see strong exploration and production momentum. Aureka.AX's $8.9M Victorian acquisition signals small-cap consolidation.
sectors.implications: Rotate from iron ore exposure into gold and uranium names. BHP.AX strategic uncertainty warrants caution; gold miners offer inflation and geopolitical hedges.

sectors.trend: Oil prices rising on tanker-war geopolitics (Iran, Middle East). Energy stocks rallying within ASX. Tanker disruptions unlikely to suppress supply long-term but support near-term pricing.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, and oil services names benefit from elevated crude. AUD strength may offset some commodity price gains for exporters.

sectors.trend: Bond market rout and rising mortgage rates create headwinds. Property sector 'GFC moment' raises NPL concerns for CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX. RBA unlikely to cut rates to support property.
sectors.implications: Bank earnings at risk from property-linked credit losses. Rising rates support NIM but credit cycle deterioration is the dominant risk.

sectors.trend: Housing price falls accelerating dramatically. 15-year break-even vs renting; near 50 years in select markets. RBA explicitly ruling out property rescue. GFC-level stress emerging.
sectors.implications: AVH.AX, CGP.AX, and property developers face severe downside. Consumer spending constrained by housing wealth destruction.

sectors.trend: Aussies feeling poorer, taking second jobs. Cost-of-living pressure intensifying. Cigarette tax debate may boost tobacco revenue. Car supply crunch raising insurance premiums.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX, and defensive staples outperform. Discretionary names (SGH.AX, LPX.AX) face demand softness.

sectors.trend: Global tech: Nvidia's Hugging Face deal hedges custom silicon risk; cybersecurity stocks up 90% in 2026. ASX tech remains thin. CSL.AX steady as defensive healthcare play.
sectors.implications: Limited ASX-listed tech exposure; global tech strength is a sentiment tailwind. CSL.AX and SGH.AX remain core defensive holdings.

key_themes: Bond market rout and global financial stability risk
Iron ore structural decline vs gold/uranium strength
Australian property market in accelerated correction with no RBA rescue
Rising mortgage rates and household financial stress
Geopolitical risk premium (Iran, Russia-Germany, North Korea-Russia)
AUD strength as a double-edged sword for exporters
Global risk-off rotation: ultra-rich moving to cash
El Nino weather risk for agricultural and energy supply chains

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global bond market rout / financial crisis trajectory
risk_assessment.mitigation: Increase allocation to short-duration bonds, gold, and cash. Reduce leverage. Monitor US Treasury yields and credit spreads.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Australian property market acceleration / GFC-level stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight property REITs and developers. Monitor NAB.AX/CBA.AX NPL trends. RBA inaction confirmed (headline 47).

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse impacting BHP.AX and FMG.AX
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce iron ore exposure; rotate into gold and diversified miners. BHP.AX strategic pivot uncertain.
Maintain gold and energy hedges. Monitor oil supply disruption risk.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Rising mortgage rates and household debt stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Consumer staples and defensive equities preferred. Monitor RBA cash rate path and household delinquency data.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: El Nino weather disruption to agriculture and energy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor SUG.AX, WBC.AX (agri exposure), and energy supply chains.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners and uranium explorers
opportunities.rationale: Gold at elevated levels on geopolitical risk and bond rout; Forrestania, Kaiser, Manhattan, Larvotto delivering production and discovery upside. Uranium (Infini) benefits from energy transition demand.

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure on oil price strength
opportunities.rationale: Tanker wars and Middle East tensions support crude pricing. Energy stocks rallying within ASX.

opportunities.recommendation: Maintain defensive core in CSL.AX and WES.AX
opportunities.rationale: Healthcare and consumer staples provide resilience amid property correction and household stress.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or exit property REIT and developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Accelerating price falls, RBA inaction confirmed, GFC-level stress. No policy rescue expected.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim iron ore concentration; diversify away from BHP.AX/FMG.AX
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural decline; BHP.AX facing strategic existential questions. Demand outlook deteriorating.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash and short-duration bond allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Bond market rout and global risk-off rotation (ultra-rich moving to cash). CD rates up to 4.35% APY offer yield without equity risk.
Property stress and rising mortgage rates threaten credit quality. RBA unlikely to ease, limiting NIM support.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure. Bond market rout, property correction, and AUD strength weigh on sentiment. Energy and gold provide pockets of strength. Expect volatility around geopolitical headlines (Iran, Russia). RBA on hold. 1–3 month range: ^AXJO testing support.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Property correction may deepen before stabilising. Iron ore structural decline continues. Gold and uranium offer structural upside. Household stress may suppress consumer spending through 2027. RBA policy constrained by inflation vs growth trade-off. Global bond market stability is the key swing factor.
